name: Fake Sick!
desc:
You're not sick. Bacon Mom can't find out.

Skip school with up to 3 friends. Play NOOB QUEST under the blanket fort for cash, and when you hear her slippers on the stairs, hide the GamePal and fake sleep before the door opens. Last until 3 PM and the day is yours. Make it to Friday for Perfect Attendance (At Home).

🤒 Fool her thermometer and cough checks
🎮 Upgrade from a GamePal to the Golden Handheld
🏰 Build your fort up to the MEGA FORT
🗝️ Unlock the house: downstairs, the kitchen, the big TV
🦠 Catch sicknesses with perks and moves: Fever, Pink Eye, Zombie Flu and more
🐶 Watch the dog. He snitches.
🚨 15 ways to get caught. Find them all.

One kid gets caught? Save them with a Doctor's Note.
